nokha.name: Nokha

canon_ref.note: Fast, lucid female Raskghar who kills a Gold-rank adventurer in the failed raid (5.43). Leads the awakened. Her fate after 5.44 is open.

nokha.summary: The first Raskghar to think and speak. She is quick and cruel, mocks Calruz and fights Lyonette and Moore in the final battle.

pebblesnatch.name: Pebblesnatch

canon_ref.note: A small Cave Goblin that Erin spares by teaching the Redfangs about 'sides' (5.36; female in the text). She opens the doors in the final battle (5.44).

pebblesnatch.summary: A young Cave Goblin who becomes Erin's first friend among her kind and her guide to the Cave Goblins.

elirr.name: Elirr

canon_ref.note: Old Gnoll leader among Calruz's captives. Leads them, frees Mrsha and breaks out in 5.43.

elirr.summary: An old Gnoll who keeps the captives together and shields Mrsha from the others.

vakk.name: Vakk

canon_ref.note: A captive Gnoll who blames Mrsha's white fur (5.42). Sacrificed on Calruz's altar (5.43).

vakk.summary: A fearful Gnoll captive who does not trust the white pup.

bevussa_slenderscale.name: Bevussa Slenderscale

canon_ref.note: Pallass adventurer who arrives through the door (5.36). Race is not confirmed: one reading says Garuda, the name looks Drake.

bevussa_slenderscale.summary: A Pallass flier and adventurer who joins the raid on the Raskghar.

keldrass.name: Keldrass

canon_ref.note: Captain of the Flamewardens, a Gold-rank team that breathes fire (5.36, 5.40). Runs the team-leader meetings in 5.38.

keldrass.summary: A Pallass team captain who burns the animated armours and organises the Gold-ranks.

earlia.name: Earlia

canon_ref.note: Captain of the Silver team Gemhammer, ex-miners with a sledgehammer (5.27, 5.29). Race is not stated.

earlia.summary: A blunt dungeon-diver who insists on going in despite the guild's warnings.

nailren.name: Nailren

canon_ref.note: Leader of the Gnoll team Pride of Kelia, of the Fletchsing Tribe (5.27, 5.29).

nailren.summary: A Gnoll team leader who flinches at Mrsha's white fur and still joins the hunt.

joiah_kellisman.name: Joiah Kellisman

canon_ref.note: Celum blacksmith who sells Erin five steel swords and a recurve bow after Drassi talks him round (5.41). Race is not stated.

joiah_kellisman.summary: A Celum smith who first doubts Erin because of a rumour, then sells to her.

xess.name: Xess

canon_ref.note: Captain of the Gold team Reldiev Scalers, spotted early in the failed raid (5.43). Race is not stated.

xess.summary: A Gold-rank captain whose team loses a member in the attack on the camp.

cassa.name: Cassa

canon_ref.note: Drake of the Reldiev Scalers; Nokha kills her in the failed raid (5.43).

cassa.summary: A Gold-rank Drake who dies in the first attack on the Raskghar camp.

fess.name: Fess

canon_ref.note: Silver-rank Drake of the Tail of Xil; a trap with a scraped-off warning mark kills him (5.38).

fess.summary: A Silver-rank dungeon-diver killed by a hidden trap.

rebat.name: Rebat

canon_ref.note: A Gold-rank adventurer who died in the fighting (named as dead in 5.39). Race is not stated.

rebat.summary: A Gold-rank adventurer lost to the Raskghar.

minerva.name: Minerva

canon_ref.note: Gold-rank [Rogue] with a pet mouse; leads the strike force's rear tunnel entry at Dwarfhalls Rest (5.32 G). Badly wounded in 5.37 G.

minerva.summary: A Gold-rank Rogue in Tyrion's strike force who is wounded fighting the Goblins.

jackal.name: Jackal

canon_ref.note: Gold-rank [Ranger] in the strike force that enters the mountain by portal circle (5.32 G).

jackal.summary: A Gold-rank Ranger who hunts the Keening Hunt team.

elia_arcsinger.name: Elia Arcsinger

canon_ref.note: Tyrion's Gold-rank ally; Tremborag shouts 'Kingslayer' and flees when she appears (5.32 G, 5.37 G).

elia_arcsinger.summary: A Gold-rank adventurer whose Skill and name break the Goblin army's nerve.

aaron_vanwell.name: Aaron Vanwell

canon_ref.note: Called 'Blackmage'. An Earther protected by Wistram's Revivalists after Naili blocks Feor (Interlude - Blackmage).

aaron_vanwell.summary: An Earth-born Mage at Wistram who is watched, then taken into the Revivalists, and reunited with new Earth arrivals.

baiss.name: Baiss

canon_ref.note: Oteslia Courier who brings Klbkch a bag with a dead Antinium drone shaped like a Queen (5.33 B). Race is not stated.

baiss.summary: A Courier from Oteslia who carries a message from the other Hives.

teura.name: Teura

canon_ref.note: Mage who guards Blackmage and welcomes the new arrivals (Interlude - Blackmage). Students ambush her.

teura.summary: A Wistram mage who watches Blackmage like a jailer.

allais_vermot.name: Allais Vermot

canon_ref.note: Wiskeria's Message-Mage in the field (5.23 G). Race not stated.

allais_vermot.summary: The Mage who receives Message spells for General Wiskeria's strike force.

nil_moxae.name: Nil Moxae

canon_ref.note: One of Bethal's two Knights of the Petal (5.22 G, 5.23 G). Race not stated.

nil_moxae.summary: A Knight of the Petal who guards Lady Bethal with sword and shield.

truvia_cartiil.name: Truvia Cartiil

canon_ref.note: The other of Bethal's two Knights of the Petal, called Dame Truvia (5.22 G, 5.23 G). Race not stated.

truvia_cartiil.summary: A Dame of the Petal with a spear and a detection ring who guards Lady Bethal.
